description: Siticone NetCoreUI is a modern UI library for .NET 8 and above. Build fast, sleek, and high-performance WinForms desktop apps with hardware-accelerated, pixel-perfect controls—seamlessly integrated for a polished, modern experience.
releaseNotes:
Siticone UI Controls - Key Improvements:

IMPORTANT - PLEASE READ BEFORE UPDATING:
• Securely back up your existing projects before updating.
• Read the changelog below carefully before updating your library version.
• Contact Siticone support before updating if you have questions or need clarification.
• Test the new version in a separate test project before applying it to a production project.

BACKWARD COMPATIBILITY:
• All updated controls remain backward compatible with existing projects.
• Existing public properties, methods, events, themes, and common usage patterns have been preserved.
• Always test the updated package in a separate project before deploying it to an existing production application.

GENERAL IMPROVEMENTS:
• Improved rendering performance across the updated controls.
• Reduced unnecessary redraws for faster and more responsive interfaces.
• Improved animation smoothness and interaction feedback.
• Reduced flickering during resizing, hovering, clicking, state changes, and animations.
• Improved visual consistency across different sizes, layouts, containers, and themes.
• Improved design-time support and smart-tag organization.
• Added clearer Siticone property and event categories for easier identification in the Properties window.
• Expanded event support with more useful information for application handlers.
• Improved keyboard accessibility and interaction support where applicable.
• Improved customization copy-and-paste support while preserving each control's identity, name, position, size, and layout settings.
• Added clear confirmation messages after successfully copying or pasting control customization.
• All updated controls remain compatible with C# 7.3.

SITICONE ADVANCED PANEL:
• Fixed transparent-background rendering so the panel no longer displays an unwanted black background.
• Improved transparency when the panel is placed on forms, panels, images, and nested controls.
• Improved rounded-corner rendering and border quality.
• Added a subtle and professional default border style.
• Improved animation smoothness and visual-state transitions.
• Improved performance when multiple panels are displayed or animated.
• Added professional theme presets for faster visual customization.
• Added smart tags with automatic display support.
• Added right-click options for copying and pasting panel customization.
• Copying customization now preserves the individual identity and layout of the destination panel.
• Expanded panel events with useful animation, theme, state, mouse, layout, and container information.
• Updated the designer so SiticoneAdvancedPanel remains a fully functional container for child controls.

SITICONE AUDIO:
• Refined the speaker, mute, sound-wave, and volume-indicator graphics.
• Improved icon alignment, proportions, and visual clarity.
• Added a cleaner and more professional default appearance.
• Circular background styling is now disabled by default.
• Background shadows, particles, and ripple effects are disabled by default for a cleaner appearance.
• The volume indicator is now disabled by default.
• Improved hover, click, mute, volume, and drag interactions.
• Improved animation smoothness while reducing unnecessary processing when the control is idle.
• Added multiple professional theme presets.
• Added optional circular background styling for applications that require it.
• Added smart tags with automatic display support.
• Added customization copy-and-paste commands.
• Expanded events for volume changes, mute changes, dragging, hovering, themes, interactions, limits, and animations.
• Events now provide useful information such as previous and new values, input source, pointer location, volume, mute state, and interaction details.

SITICONE DOWNLOAD BUTTON:
• Refined the default design with professional colors, spacing, borders, typography, and rounded corners.
• Improved the download, loading, completed, paused, and error icons.
• Preserved and refined the animated loading spinner.
• Improved progress animation and state transitions.
• Improved hover and pressed-state feedback.
• Reduced flickering during progress updates and state changes.
• Improved performance during long-running downloads and frequent progress updates.
• Added professional theme presets.
• Added multiple progress-display styles.
• Improved keyboard interaction using Enter and Space.
• Improved web-download handling, cancellation, progress reporting, and error feedback.
• Expanded download events with useful information such as received bytes, total bytes, transfer speed, elapsed time, estimated remaining time, source, and destination.
• Added events for download starting, cancellation, state changes, hover changes, pressed-state changes, completion, errors, and themes.
• Added smart tags with automatic display support.
• Added right-click and smart-tag customization copy-and-paste options.
• Copying customization preserves the destination control's identity and layout settings.

SITICONE EMOJI RATING:
• Completely refined the default emoji-rating design.
• Improved emoji alignment so each emoji is accurately centered.
• Improved hover and selection visibility.
• Hover and selection indicators now render as true circles.
• All control backgrounds, borders, indicators, and rounded visual elements now remain fully rounded.
• Removed the unwanted dot from the selected indicator.
• Removed dotted hover indicators.
• The hover indicator now uses a solid circular border consistent with the selected indicator.
• Hover indicators now disappear correctly when the pointer leaves an emoji or exits the control.
• Hover indicators now respond to the selected theme instead of always appearing gray.
• The selected emoji no longer receives hover, press, movement, or pulse effects.
• Clicking the selected emoji now cleanly deselects it.
• Emoji interactions now use smooth scaling without shaking or unstable movement.
• Removed movement-based shake effects from normal interactions.
• Improved hover, press, selection, deselection, and read-only feedback.
• Tooltips are disabled by default and can be enabled when required.
• Fixed repeated emoji rendering.
• Improved support for custom emojis and custom emoji images.
• Added improved keyboard navigation and selection controls.
• Added rating hit-testing and emoji-bound access for advanced usage.
• Improved rating save and load support.
• Added exactly 32 theme presets.
• Theme presets are now more distinctive, meaningful, and visually different from one another.
• Added themes including Neon Cyber, Sakura Blossom, Desert Sand, Arctic Ice, Midnight Gold, Tropical Punch, Retro Arcade, and other professional styles.
• Added comprehensive events for rating changes, selection clearing, hovering, pressing, invalid interactions, vote counts, persistence, themes, and animations.
• Rating events now provide useful information such as previous and new ratings, emoji details, input source, pointer location, keyboard input, and cancellation state.
• Added smart tags with automatic display support.
• Added customization copy-and-paste options while preserving each control's identity and layout.

DESIGN-TIME EXPERIENCE:
• Improved smart-tag organization across the updated controls.
• Smart tags now open automatically where supported.
• Added theme selection and commonly used settings to smart tags.
• Added convenient design-time preview, reset, copy, and paste actions.
• Improved Properties window categories using consistent Siticone naming.
• Improved designer compatibility and control-container behavior.
• Improved designer notifications so property changes are reflected more reliably.

RECOMMENDED UPDATE PROCESS:
• Back up your solution and all related projects.
• Create a separate test project or test branch.
• Install or reference the updated Siticone library.
• Rebuild the entire solution.
• Open all affected forms in the Visual Studio designer.
• Test control appearance in all supported themes.
• Test mouse, keyboard, touch, hover, selection, and animation behavior.
• Test copied and pasted customization on separate control instances.
• Test application events and confirm handlers receive the expected data.
• Test downloads, cancellation, errors, completion, and progress reporting where the Siticone Download Button is used.
• Test transparency and nested controls where Siticone Advanced Panel is used.
• Test volume, mute, and drag interactions where Siticone Audio is used.
• Test hover, selection, deselection, keyboard navigation, and themes where Siticone Emoji Rating is used.
• Deploy to production only after completing application-level testing.
